title: 完整人工智能培训课程资源库
summary: 该仓库是Fernando Amaral教授的完整AI培训课程配套资源，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法和模糊逻辑等，包含Python实践、项目和笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for Prof. Fernando Amaral's Complete AI Training, covering ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, CV, anomaly detection, genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic, with Python hands-on practice and notebooks.
